text:
emma: Security advisory: a public gist (reported externally) contains what looks like a telemetry ingestion API key for redwood-telemetry-prod. Detected 2026-12-10T04:12Z. We need immediate rotation and to lock ingestion to known egress IPs.

secops-bot: [ALERT] public-credential-leak source=gist detected_key_id=telemetry-ingest-prod at 2026-12-10T04:14:02Z.

raj: Confirmed key in gist matches ingestion key fingerprint. Likely from a developer paste. Immediate actions: rotate ingestion key, revoke old key, update ingestion endpoints to require mTLS from trusted clients, block the leaked key in the gateway, and scan logs for suspicious uploads.

ops-oncall: Ran detection query:
```
# find uploads authenticated with the leaked key in last 48h
gcloud logging read "resource.type=api AND jsonPayload.auth.key_id=\"telemetry-ingest-prod\" AND timestamp>\"2026-12-08T04:00:00Z\"" --limit 1000
```
Found 18 upload requests from two unusual IP ranges. Marking for investigation.

emma: Mitigation now: gateway will reject requests using leaked key (soft for 5m to avoid outages), then hard-reject. Oncall, please rotate the key in KMS and generate new key pair with 1h TTL for ingestion tokens.

ops-oncall: Rotated telemetry-ingest key to telemetry-ingest-prod-v2 in KMS and pushed updated secret to ingestion fleet config. Gateway soft-reject set at 2026-12-10T04:35Z.

devex: We'll add SDK helper to fetch ephemeral ingestion tokens (STS) and document the migration. Target a minor SDK release in 24h.

legal: If the gist belongs to a contractor or partner, we need to notify and preserve evidence. I'll open LEGAL-INV-332 and coordinate.

cs: Customer impact: none reported; telemetry may have dropped for some clients during the soft-reject. I'll prepare a short CS note explaining rotation and no customer data exposure detected so far.

raj: Forensics: snapshot the two IP ranges and check for outbound data egress. Also search public places for duplicate copies of the gist.

secops-bot: [TASK] TELE-ROTATE-210 created to track rotation, gateway rule, and forensic audit.

ops-oncall: Forensics update: two IPs correlate to a CI cluster from partner-ci.example.com. Reached out to partner; they've disabled the runner and rotated credentials. No large-volume uploads found.

emma: Final: old key revoked and scheduled destroy after 7-day quarantine. Postmortem owner: raj. We'll publish a short exec summary after investigation. Thanks all.
